units.zh: 列傳二百四十七
units.en: Biography 247
units.literal: Biographies, number two hundred forty-seven.

units.zh: 左寶貴弟寶賢等永山鄧世昌劉步蟾林泰曾等戴宗騫
units.en: Zuo Baogui (and his younger brother Bao Xian and others), Yong Shan, Deng Shichang, Liu Buchan, Lin Taiceng and others, and Dai Zongqian
units.literal: Zuo Baogui; his younger brother Bao Xian and others; Yong Shan; Deng Shichang; Liu Buchan; Lin Taiceng and others; Dai Zongqian.

units.zh: 左寶貴，字冠廷，山東費人。
units.en: Zuo Baogui, styled Guanting, was a native of Fei County in Shandong.
units.literal: Zuo Baogui, courtesy name Guanting, a man of Fei in Shandong.

units.zh: 咸豐初，隸江南軍。
units.en: In the early Xianfeng era he served with the Jiangnan forces.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Xianfeng reign, he was attached to the Jiangnan army.

units.zh: 嘗令當前敵，陣既接，旗兵中砲，殪，寶貴持其幟衝鋒入，大捷，繇是知名。
units.en: Once placed in the forefront against the enemy, he saw the standard-bearer cut down by cannon fire as battle was joined; Baogui seized the banner and led the charge himself, winning a great victory, and from that day his name was known.
units.literal: Once ordered to face the enemy in the van; when the lines met, the banner soldier was struck by cannon and killed; Baogui seized the standard and charged in at the head; a great victory; from this he became known.

units.zh: 獲苗沛霖，克金陵，頻有功。
units.en: He helped capture Miao Peilin, took Nanjing, and won distinction again and again.
units.literal: He captured Miao Peilin, took Jinling, and repeatedly had merit.

units.zh: 後以游擊從僧格林沁討捻，積勳至副將。
units.en: Later, as a guerrilla officer under Sengge Rinchen in the campaign against the Nian rebels, he rose by accumulated merit to vice commander.
units.literal: Later, as a guerrilla officer he followed Sengge Rinchen in suppressing the Nian, accumulating merit until vice commander.

units.zh: 光緒初，尚書崇實巡視奉天、吉林，奏自隨。
units.en: Early in the Guangxu reign, when Minister Chongshi toured Fengtian and Jilin, he memorialized that Baogui accompany him.
units.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu, Minister Chongshi inspected Fengtian and Jilin and memorialized that he accompany him.

units.zh: 既至，斬高希珍於土門，誅宋三好於石砬子。
units.en: On arrival he beheaded Gao Xizhen at Tumen and put Song Sanhao to death at Shibazi.
units.literal: After arriving, he beheaded Gao Xizhen at Tumen and executed Song Sanhao at Shibazi.

units.zh: 邊外東北廟溝金宮四構黨圖大舉，复捕治之，餘燼悉平，賜號鏗色巴圖魯，晉記名提督。
units.en: When conspirators beyond the border at Dongbei Miaogou and Jingongsi plotted a major uprising, he captured and punished them again until every ember of revolt was extinguished; he was granted the title Kense Batulu and advanced to registered nominal provincial commander.
units.literal: Beyond the border, conspirators at Dongbei Miaogou and Jingongsi plotted a great rising; he again captured and punished them; remaining embers were all pacified; he was granted the title Kense Batulu and promoted to registered nominal provincial commander.

units.zh: 授高州鎮總兵，仍留奉天。
units.en: He was appointed commander of the Gaozhou garrison but continued to serve in Fengtian.
units.literal: He was appointed commander of the Gaozhou garrison but remained in Fengtian.

units.zh: 平朝陽教匪，賞黃馬褂、雙眼花翎，駐瀋陽。
units.en: After pacifying the sect rebels in Chaoyang he was rewarded with the yellow riding jacket and double-eyed peacock feather, and took up station at Shenyang.
units.literal: He pacified the sect rebels in Chaoyang, was rewarded with the yellow jacket and double-eyed peacock feather, and was stationed at Shenyang.

units.zh: 二十年，朝鮮亂起，日本進兵。
units.en: In the twentieth year of Guangxu, turmoil broke out in Korea and Japan sent troops.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, disorder arose in Korea and Japan advanced troops.

units.zh: 朝議既決戰，衛汝貴、馬玉昆、丰紳阿各率所部往御之，寶貴自奉天來會，是為四大軍。
units.en: Once the court resolved on war, Wei Rugui, Ma Yukun, and Fengshen'e each led their commands to resist the invader; Baogui came down from Fengtian to join them — the force known as the Four Great Armies.
units.literal: Once the court had decided on war, Wei Rugui, Ma Yukun, and Fengshen'e each led their units to resist; Baogui came from Fengtian to join them — these were the Four Great Armies.

units.zh: 慮海道梗，乃繞道自遼東行，渡鴨綠江入平壤。
units.en: Fearing the sea lanes would be cut, they marched overland through eastern Liaodong, crossed the Yalu, and entered Pyongyang.
units.literal: Fearing the sea route would be blocked, they took a detour through eastern Liaodong, crossed the Yalu River, and entered Pyongyang.

units.zh: 是時葉志超虛飾戰胜狀，電李鴻章入告，遂拜總統諸軍命。
units.en: At that time Ye Zhichao dressed up false reports of victory and telegraphed Li Hongzhang with the news, and was accordingly appointed commander-in-chief of all forces.
units.literal: At that time Ye Zhichao falsely reported victories and telegraphed Li Hongzhang; he was then appointed commander-in-chief of all forces.

units.zh: 於是汝貴、玉昆軍南門外大同江，志超部將江自康軍北門外小山，寶貴任城守。
units.en: Rugui and Yukun took position on the Datong River south of the southern gate; Ye Zhichao's subordinate Jiang Zikang held the hill north of the northern gate; and Baogui was charged with defending the city itself.
units.literal: Thereupon Rugui's and Yukun's troops were on the Datong River south of the southern gate; Ye Zhichao's subordinate Jiang Zikang's troops on the hill north of the northern gate; Baogui was charged with holding the city.

units.zh: 未止舍，日軍猝至，寶貴與丰紳阿擊卻之。
units.en: They had scarcely made camp when Japanese troops struck without warning; Baogui and Fengshen'e drove them back.
units.literal: Before they had even settled in camp, Japanese troops suddenly arrived; Baogui and Fengshen'e beat them back.

units.zh: 敵退龍岡，分道來攻，又敗之。
units.en: The enemy fell back to Longgang and attacked along several routes; they were beaten again.
units.literal: The enemy withdrew to Longgang and attacked by separate routes; they were defeated again.

units.zh: 志超乃聚全軍為嬰城計。
units.en: Ye Zhichao then drew the whole army together to hold the city behind its walls.
units.literal: Ye Zhichao then gathered the entire army to plan a purely defensive holding of the city.

units.zh: 時寶貴扼玄武門，日軍大隊至。
units.en: Baogui was holding the Xuanwu Gate when a large Japanese column came up.
units.literal: Baogui then held the Xuanwu Gate when a large Japanese force arrived.

units.zh: 志超將潰圍北歸，寶貴不從，以兵守志超勿令逸。
units.en: Ye Zhichao was preparing to break out northward; Baogui refused to go along and posted troops to keep Ye from slipping away.
units.literal: Ye Zhichao was about to break out of the encirclement and flee north; Baogui would not agree and stationed troops to watch Ye and prevent his escape.

units.zh: 寶貴狃於捕馬賊之功，頗輕敵。
units.en: Baogui, overconfident after years of chasing down mounted bandits, took the enemy too lightly.
units.literal: Baogui, accustomed to his successes against horse bandits, rather underestimated the enemy.

units.zh: 日軍轝砲散置山巔，諜者以告，若弗聞。
units.en: The Japanese had scattered their field guns on the heights; spies brought word of it, but he acted as though he had not heard.
units.literal: The Japanese scattered their siege guns on the mountain peaks; spies reported this, but he seemed not to hear.

units.zh: 登城指麾，中砲踣，猶能言，及城下，始殞。
units.en: He climbed the wall to direct the defense, was struck down by shellfire, and could still speak; only after he was carried below the wall did he die.
units.literal: He mounted the wall to direct operations, was struck by cannon fire and fell; he could still speak, but only after being carried below the wall did he die.

units.zh: 其部將負屍開城走，遇日軍，又棄之，於是諸軍皆潰。
units.en: His officers shouldered his body, opened the gates, and fled; when they ran into Japanese troops they abandoned the corpse, and the whole army collapsed in rout.
units.literal: His subordinate generals carried his corpse and opened the gates to flee; when they met Japanese troops they abandoned the body, and then all the armies routed.

units.zh: 事聞，贈太子少保，諡忠壯，予騎都尉兼一云騎尉世職，子國楫襲。
units.en: When the court learned of his death, he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang (Loyal and Stalwart), and granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Yun Commandant rank; his son Guoji inherited the title.
units.literal: When word reached the court, he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang, and awarded a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Yun Commandant rank; his son Guoji inherited.

units.zh: 弟寶賢、寶清先後於直隸、奉天剿匪陣亡。
units.en: His younger brothers Bao Xian and Bao Qing had earlier fallen in battle while suppressing bandits in Zhili and Fengtian, one after the other.
units.literal: His younger brothers Bao Xian and Bao Qing successively died in battle while suppressing bandits in Zhili and Fengtian.

units.zh: 永山，袁氏，漢軍正白旗人，黑龍江駐防，吉林將軍富明阿子，黑龍江將軍壽山弟。
units.en: Yong Shan, of the Yuan clan, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White Banner, stationed in the Heilongjiang garrison; he was the son of Jilin General Fuming'a and the younger brother of Heilongjiang General Shoushan.
units.literal: Yong Shan, of the Yuan clan, a Hanjun of the Plain White Banner, garrisoned at Heilongjiang; son of Jilin General Fuming'a and younger brother of Heilongjiang General Shoushan.

units.zh: 以廕授侍衛，歸東三省練軍。
units.en: By hereditary privilege he was appointed an Imperial Bodyguard and returned to serve with the training army of the Three Eastern Provinces.
units.literal: By yin privilege he was appointed an Imperial Bodyguard and returned to the Three Eastern Provinces training army.

units.zh: 中日戰起，從將軍依克唐阿軍，率黑龍江騎旅駐摩天嶺。
units.en: When war broke out between China and Japan, he served under General Yiketang'a, commanding the Heilongjiang cavalry brigade posted at Motianling.
units.literal: When the Sino-Japanese War broke out, he followed General Yiketang'a's army, leading the Heilongjiang cavalry brigade stationed at Motianling.

units.zh: 永山臨敵輒深入，為士卒先。
units.en: Whenever he met the enemy Yong Shan drove deep into the fight, always ahead of his men.
units.literal: Whenever Yong Shan faced the enemy he would press deep into the line, going ahead of his soldiers.

units.zh: 與日軍戰數有功，連殲其將。
units.en: In repeated clashes with the Japanese he distinguished himself and killed several of their officers in succession.
units.literal: In several engagements with the Japanese army he won merit and successively killed many of their officers.

units.zh: 既克龍灣，乘勝渡草河，規鳳凰，依克唐阿策襲其城，檄永山為軍鋒，偕壽山分率馬步隊深入攻之。
units.en: After taking Longwan they pressed the advantage across the Cao River toward Fengcheng; Yiketang'a planned a surprise on the city and named Yong Shan the vanguard, while he and Shoushan each led mixed cavalry and infantry columns in a deep strike.
units.literal: After capturing Longwan, they took advantage of the victory to cross the Cao River and aimed at Fengcheng; Yiketang'a planned a surprise assault on the city and ordered Yong Shan as the vanguard, together with Shoushan each leading mixed horse and foot columns in a deep attack.

units.zh: 抵一面山，距城八里，張左右翼，各據一坡以待。
units.en: They reached Yimianshan, eight li from the city, and deployed left and right wings, each holding a slope in readiness.
units.literal: They reached Yimianshan, eight li from the city, deployed left and right wings, each occupying a slope in wait.

units.zh: 永山為右翼，尤得地勢。
units.en: Yong Shan held the right wing, which had the better ground.
units.literal: Yong Shan commanded the right wing and especially held the superior terrain.

units.zh: 敵作散隊，伍伍什什冒死前，復以大隊橫沖我左翼。
units.en: The enemy came on in open order, advancing in small groups at the risk of their lives, then threw a large column in a slashing charge against our left wing.
units.literal: The enemy formed skirmish lines, advancing in fives and tens risking death, then sent a large column to charge straight across our left wing.

units.zh: 左翼潰，右翼亦不支，乃相繼退。
units.en: The left wing broke, the right could not hold, and the whole line fell back in turn.
units.literal: The left wing collapsed and the right wing could not hold either, so they withdrew in succession.

units.zh: 永山獨為殿，遇伏，連受槍傷，洞胸踣，復強起督戰，大呼殺賊而逝。
units.en: Yong Shan alone covered the retreat; ambushed, he took shot after shot, was pierced through the chest and fell; he dragged himself up to rally the fight, cried "Kill the bandits!" and died.
units.literal: Yong Shan alone served as rearguard; ambushed, he received gunshot wounds one after another, was struck through the chest and fell; he forced himself up again to direct the battle, shouted "Kill the bandits!" and died.

units.zh: 事聞，諡壯愍，予建祠奉天。
units.en: When the court learned of his death, he was given the posthumous name Zhuangmin (Stalwart and Sorrowful), and a temple was built for him in Fengtian.
units.literal: When word reached the court, he was given the posthumous name Zhuangmin and a temple was erected for him in Fengtian.

units.zh: 鄧世昌，字正卿，廣東番禺人。
units.en: Deng Shichang, styled Zhengqing, was a native of Panyu in Guangdong.
units.literal: Deng Shichang, courtesy name Zhengqing, a native of Panyu in Guangdong.

units.zh: 少有幹略，嘗從西人習布算術。
units.en: Even as a youth he showed ability and enterprise, and he once studied Western bookkeeping under foreign teachers.
units.literal: In youth he showed administrative talent and once studied Western bookkeeping under Westerners.

units.zh: 既長，入水師學堂，精測量、駕駛。
units.en: When he came of age he entered the naval academy and mastered surveying and ship handling.
units.literal: When grown, he entered the naval academy and mastered surveying and navigation.

units.zh: 光緒初，管海東雲艦，徼循海口。
units.en: Early in the Guangxu reign he commanded the Haidongyun and patrolled the coastal harbors.
units.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu, he commanded the coastal ship Haidongyun and patrolled the harbors.

units.zh: 日本窺台灣，扼澎湖、基隆諸隘，補千總，調管振威艦。
units.en: When Japan cast its eye on Taiwan and seized the passes at Penghu and Keelung, he was made a thousand-man commander and transferred to command the Zhenwei.
units.literal: When Japan cast covetous eyes on Taiwan and held the passes at Penghu and Keelung, he was appointed thousand-man commander and transferred to command the Zhenwei.

units.zh: 以捕海盜，遷守備。
units.en: For capturing pirates he was promoted to garrison commander.
units.literal: For capturing pirates he was promoted to garrison commander.

units.zh: 李鴻章治海軍，高其能，調北洋。
units.en: When Li Hongzhang built up the navy, he prized Shichang's ability and transferred him to the Beiyang Fleet.
units.literal: When Li Hongzhang organized the navy, he valued Shichang's ability and transferred him to the Beiyang Fleet.

units.zh: 從丁汝昌赴英購鐵艦，益詳練海戰術。
units.en: He accompanied Ding Ruchang to England to buy ironclads and grew thoroughly versed in naval tactics.
units.literal: He accompanied Ding Ruchang to England to purchase ironclads and became even more thoroughly versed in naval tactics.

units.zh: 八年，朝鮮內亂，復從汝昌泊仁川，為吳長慶陸軍後距。
units.en: In the eighth year of Guangxu, during civil strife in Korea, he again followed Ruchang to anchor at Incheon and covered Wu Changqing's land forces from the sea.
units.literal: In the eighth year, during internal disorder in Korea, he again followed Ruchang to anchor at Incheon, covering Wu Changqing's land army from the rear.

units.zh: 事寧，遷游擊，賜號勃勇巴圖魯。
units.en: When the crisis passed he was promoted to guerrilla officer and granted the title Boyong Batulu.
units.literal: When affairs were settled, he was promoted to guerrilla officer and granted the title Boyong Batulu.

units.zh: 管揚威快艦，往來天津、朝鮮；
units.en: He commanded the fast cruiser Yangwei, shuttling between Tianjin and Korea;
units.literal: He commanded the fast cruiser Yangwei, traveling between Tianjin and Korea;

units.zh: 冬寒冰沍，巡視台、廈海防。
units.en: and in winter, when the seas froze over, he patrolled the defenses of Taiwan and Xiamen.
units.literal: in winter when ice blocked the sea, he patrolled the coastal defenses of Taiwan and Xiamen.

units.zh: 尋充經遠、致遠、靖遠、濟遠四船營務處，兼致遠管帶。
units.en: Soon afterward he joined the fleet staff overseeing the Jingyuan, Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, and Jiyuan, while also commanding the Zhiyuan herself.
units.literal: Soon afterward he joined the fleet staff overseeing the Jingyuan, Zhiyuan, Jingyuan, and Jiyuan, while also commanding the Zhiyuan herself.

units.zh: 十四年，台灣生番畔，以副將從汝昌往討。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, when the aborigines of Taiwan rose in revolt, he went as vice commander under Ruchang to suppress them.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, when aborigines in Taiwan rebelled, as vice commander he followed Ruchang to suppress them.

units.zh: 戰埤南，毀其碉寨，擢總兵。
units.en: Fighting at Beinan he destroyed their stockaded forts and was promoted to full commander.
units.literal: Fighting at Beinan, he destroyed their stockaded forts and was promoted to full commander.

units.zh: 時定海軍經制，借補中軍副將，而以汝昌為提督，其左右翼總兵則閩人林泰曾、劉步蟾也。
units.en: When the navy's permanent organization was fixed, he was made acting central vice commander under Admiral Ding Ruchang; the left and right wing commanders were the Fujian men Lin Taiceng and Liu Buchan.
units.literal: At that time the navy's permanent establishment was fixed; he was appointed acting central vice commander while Ruchang served as admiral; the left and right wing commanders were the Fujian men Lin Taiceng and Liu Buchan.

units.zh: 汝昌故不習海戰，威令不行。
units.en: Ruchang had never been trained in naval warfare, and his authority did not hold.
units.literal: Ruchang was originally unversed in naval warfare and his authority did not take hold.

units.zh: 獨世昌以粵人任管駕，非時不登岸，閩人咸嫉之。
units.en: Only Shichang, a Cantonese in command of a ship, would not leave his vessel except when he had to; the Fujian officers all resented him for it.
units.literal: Only Shichang, as a Cantonese holding command of a ship, would not go ashore except when necessary; the Fujian men all envied him.

units.zh: 二十年夏，日侵朝，絕海道。
units.en: In the summer of the twentieth year Japan invaded Korea and cut the sea lanes.
units.literal: In the summer of the twentieth year, Japan invaded Korea and cut the sea lanes.

units.zh: 鴻章令濟遠、廣乙兩船赴牙山，遇日艦，先擊，廣乙受殊傷；
units.en: Hongzhang ordered the Jiyuan and Guangyi to Asan; they met Japanese warships and opened fire first; the Guangyi was badly mauled;
units.literal: Hongzhang ordered the Jiyuan and Guangyi to proceed to Asan; they met Japanese warships and opened fire first; the Guangyi received severe damage;

units.zh: 轟濟遠，都司沈壽昌，守備楊建章、黃承勳中砲死。
units.en: they turned their fire on the Jiyuan; Director Shen Shouchang and Garrison Commanders Yang Jianzhang and Huang Chengxun were killed by shellfire.
units.literal: they bombarded the Jiyuan; Director Shen Shouchang and Garrison Commanders Yang Jianzhang and Huang Chengxun were killed by cannon fire.

units.zh: 濟遠逃，日艦追之，管帶方柏謙豎白幟，追益亟，有水手發砲擊之，折日艦了樓，柏謙虛張胜狀，退塞威海東西兩口。
units.en: The Jiyuan fled with Japanese ships in pursuit; Commander Fang Boqian ran up a white flag, which only made the pursuit fiercer; a sailor fired back and knocked down the enemy's signal mast; Boqian then falsely claimed a victory and withdrew to block the eastern and western entrances to Weihai.
units.literal: The Jiyuan fled and Japanese warships pursued; Commander Fang Boyian hoisted a white flag, whereupon the pursuit intensified; a sailor fired on them and broke the Japanese ship's signal tower; Boyian falsely claimed victory and withdrew to block the eastern and western entrances to Weihai.

units.zh: 世昌憤欲進兵，汝昌尼其行，不果。
units.en: Shichang, furious, wanted to advance to the fight, but Ruchang held him back and nothing came of it.
units.literal: Shichang, indignant, wished to advance; Ruchang restrained him and it did not happen.

units.zh: 已而日艦集大連灣，窺金州，我國海軍乃大發，泊鴨綠江大東溝，以鐵艦十當敵艦十有二。
units.en: Before long Japanese ships massed in Dalian Bay and probed Jinzhou; the Chinese navy sortied in force and anchored at Dadonggou on the Yalu, pitting ten ironclads against the enemy's twelve.
units.literal: Before long Japanese warships gathered at Dalian Bay and probed Jinzhou; our navy then sortied in force and anchored at Dadonggou on the Yalu, with ten ironclads facing the enemy's twelve.

units.zh: 汝昌乘定遠居中，列諸船左右張兩翼。
units.en: Ruchang took the Dingyuan at the center and drew up the fleet in two wings to left and right.
units.literal: Ruchang rode the Dingyuan at the center, arraying the other ships to left and right in two wings.

units.zh: 日艦魚貫進，據上風，汝昌令轟擊，距遠不能中。
units.en: The Japanese came on in column, holding the weather gauge; Ruchang ordered his guns to fire, but at that range the shots fell short.
units.literal: Japanese ships advanced in single file, holding the windward position; Ruchang ordered cannon fire, but at too great a distance they could not hit.

units.zh: 日艦小，運棹靈，倏分倏合，彈雨坌集，定遠被震，大纛僕。
units.en: The Japanese ships were smaller and more agile, breaking apart and closing again in an instant; shellfire poured down; the Dingyuan was shaken and her great battle ensign toppled.
units.literal: The Japanese ships were small and maneuvered their oars skillfully, dividing and reuniting in an instant; a rain of shells poured down; the Dingyuan was shaken and its great standard fell.

units.zh: 世昌見帥旗沒，慮軍心搖，亟取致遠纛豎之。
units.en: Shichang saw the admiral's flag gone and feared the fleet's morale would break; he quickly raised the Zhiyuan's ensign in its place.
units.literal: Shichang saw the commander's flag gone and feared the troops' morale would waver; he quickly took the Zhiyuan's standard and raised it.

units.zh: 戰良久，定遠擊沉其西京丸，我之超勇毀焉。
units.en: After a long fight the Dingyuan sank the Japanese Saikyo Maru, while our own Chaoyong was destroyed.
units.literal: After long fighting, the Dingyuan sank their Saikyo Maru, while our Chaoyong was destroyed.

units.zh: 世昌乘致遠，最猛鷙，與日艦吉野浪速相當，吉野，日艦之中堅也。
units.en: Shichang fought from the Zhiyuan, the fiercest ship in the fleet, matched against the Japanese Yoshino and Naniwa; the Yoshino was the backbone of the enemy line.
units.literal: Shichang rode the Zhiyuan, the fiercest of all, matched against the Japanese Yoshino and Nisshin; the Yoshino was the backbone of the Japanese fleet.

units.zh: 戰既酣，致遠彈將罄，世昌誓死敵。
units.en: As the fight grew desperate the Zhiyuan's ammunition ran low, and Shichang swore to fight the enemy to the death.
units.literal: When battle grew fierce, the Zhiyuan's ammunition was nearly exhausted; Shichang swore to fight the enemy to the death.

units.zh: 將士知大勢敗，陣稍亂，世昌大呼曰：「今日有死而已！
units.en: The officers and men, seeing the battle was lost, began to lose formation; Shichang cried out: "Today there is nothing for us but death!
units.literal: The officers and men, knowing the great situation was lost, the formation grew somewhat disorderly; Shichang shouted loudly: "Today there is nothing but death!

units.zh: 然雖死而海軍聲威弗替，是即所以報國也！」
units.en: Yet if we die, the navy's honor shall not fade — that is how we repay the country!"
units.literal: Yet though we die, the navy's prestige shall not fade — that is how we repay the state!"

units.zh: 眾乃定。
units.en: The men steadied at that.
units.literal: The crowd then steadied.

units.zh: 世昌遂鼓輪怒駛，欲猛觸吉野與同盡，中其魚雷，鍋船裂沉。
units.en: Shichang then drove the Zhiyuan at full speed, intending to ram the Yoshino and go down with her; a torpedo from the Japanese ship struck home, and the Zhiyuan broke apart and sank.
units.literal: Shichang then drove the screws at full speed in a fury, intending to ram the Yoshino and perish together; he was struck by its torpedo, the boilers burst, and the ship split apart and sank.

units.zh: 世昌身環氣圈不沒，汝昌及他將見之，令馳救。
units.en: Shichang was kept afloat by a life buoy and did not sink; Ruchang and the other commanders saw him and ordered a boat to hurry to his rescue.
units.literal: Shichang's body was ringed by a life buoy and did not sink; Ruchang and the other commanders saw this and ordered a rescue boat sent at speed.

units.zh: 拒弗上，縮臂出圈，死之。
units.en: He refused to be pulled aboard, slipped his arm from the life buoy, and drowned.
units.literal: He refused to board, drew his arm out of the pocket, and died.

units.zh: 其副游擊陳金揆同殉，全船二百五十人無逃者。
units.en: His deputy Chen Jin'kui died with him; of the ship's company of two hundred fifty, not one tried to escape.
units.literal: His deputy guerrilla officer Chen Jin'kui died with him; of the whole ship's two hundred fifty men, none fled.

units.zh: 經遠管帶總兵林永昇、超勇管帶參將黃建寅、揚威管帶參將林履中並殞於陣。
units.en: Lin Yongsheng, commander of the Jingyuan; Huang Jianyin, commander of the Chaoyong; and Lin Lüzhong, commander of the Yangwei — all fell in the same battle.
units.literal: Jingyuan commander Commander Lin Yongsheng, Chaoyong commander Major Huang Jianyin, and Yangwei commander Major Lin Lüzhong all fell in battle.

units.zh: 事聞，世昌諡壯節，餘皆優恤。
units.en: When the court learned of his death, Shichang was given the posthumous name Zhuangjie (Stalwart Integrity), and the others were all generously compensated.
units.literal: When word reached the court, Shichang was given the posthumous name Zhuangjie and the others were all generously compensated.

units.zh: 世昌既死，諸船或沉或逃，遂不復成軍。
units.en: After Shichang's death the remaining ships were sunk or fled, and the fleet never fought as a force again.
units.literal: After Shichang's death, the various ships were either sunk or fled, and the fleet was never re-formed.

units.zh: 世昌臨戰以忠義相激勵，死狀尤烈，世與左寶貴並稱雙忠云。
units.en: Before battle Shichang roused his men with appeals to loyalty and duty, and his death was especially heroic; he and Zuo Baogui were paired in their own day as the "Two Loyal Ones."
units.literal: Shichang before battle stirred his men with talk of loyalty and righteousness; his manner of death was especially fierce; the age paired him with Zuo Baogui as the "Two Loyal Ones."

units.zh: 永昇等，忠義有傳。
units.en: Yongsheng and the others, too, have their own stories of loyal service.
units.literal: Yongsheng and the others — their loyalty and righteousness have been handed down.

units.zh: 劉步蟾，侯官人。
units.en: Liu Buchan was a native of Houguan.
units.literal: Liu Buchan, a man of Houguan.

units.zh: 幼穎異，肄業福建船政學堂，卒業試第一。
units.en: As a boy he was unusually gifted; he studied at the Fujian Naval Academy and took first place in the graduation examination.
units.literal: In youth he was exceptionally bright; he studied at the Fujian Naval Academy and ranked first in the graduation examination.

units.zh: 隸建威船，徼循南北洋資實練。
units.en: He served aboard the Jianwei, patrolling the northern and southern seas to gain practical experience.
units.literal: He was attached to the Jianwei and patrolled the North and South Seas to gain practical training.

units.zh: 同治十一年，會考閩、廣駕駛生，复冠其曹。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, in the joint examination of Fujian and Guangdong navigation students, he again came first in his class.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, in the joint examination of Fujian and Guangdong navigation students, he again ranked first in his class.

units.zh: 自是巡歷海岸河港，所蒞輒用​​西法測量。
units.en: From then on, as he toured the coasts and river ports, he surveyed every place he visited by Western methods.
units.literal: From then on, touring coastal harbors and river ports, wherever he went he used Western methods of surveying.

units.zh: 台灣地勢、番部風土尤諳習，為圖說甚晰。
units.en: He knew Taiwan's terrain and the ways of the aboriginal districts especially well, and his illustrated reports were models of clarity.
units.literal: He was especially well versed in Taiwan's terrain and the customs of the aboriginal districts, and his illustrated accounts were very clear.

units.zh: 光緒改元，赴歐學槍砲、水雷諸技，還留福建，敘守備。
units.en: At the beginning of the Guangxu reign he went to Europe to study artillery, mines, and related skills; on his return he remained in Fujian and was appointed garrison commander.
units.literal: When the Guangxu reign began, he went to Europe to study artillery, mines, and related skills; on returning he remained in Fujian and was appointed garrison commander.

units.zh: 以丁寶楨、李鴻章論薦，擢游擊，會辦北洋操防。
units.en: On the recommendation of Ding Baozhen and Li Hongzhang he was promoted to guerrilla officer and assigned to help organize Beiyang training and coastal defense.
units.literal: On the recommendation of Ding Baozhen and Li Hongzhang, he was promoted to guerrilla officer and assisted in Beiyang training and coastal defense.

units.zh: 十一年，赴德國購定遠艦。
units.en: In the eleventh year he went to Germany to take delivery of the Dingyuan.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, he went to Germany to purchase the Dingyuan.

units.zh: 維時海軍初立，借才異地，西人實為管帶，步蟾副之。
units.en: The navy was still new and had to rely on foreign expertise; Westerners actually commanded the ships, with Buchan as their deputy.
units.literal: At that time the navy was newly established and had to borrow talent from abroad; Westerners actually served as commanders, with Buchan as deputy.

units.zh: 已而西人去，頗能舉其職。
units.en: When the Westerners left, he proved fully capable of filling their role.
units.literal: Before long the Westerners left, and he was quite able to fulfill his duties.

units.zh: 十四年，以參將赴歐領四快船歸，遷副將，賜號強勇巴圖魯，擢右翼總兵。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, as a major, he went to Europe and brought back four fast cruisers; he was promoted to vice commander, granted the title Qiangyong Batulu, and made right-wing commander.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, as a major he went to Europe to bring back four fast cruisers; he was promoted to vice commander, granted the title Qiangyong Batulu, and advanced to right-wing commander.

units.zh: 二十年，中日戰起，海軍浮泊大東溝。
units.en: In the twentieth year, when war broke out between China and Japan, the fleet lay at anchor in Dadonggou.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, when the Sino-Japanese War broke out, the navy lay at anchor in Dadonggou.

units.zh: 日艦至，督攝諸藝士御之，鏖戰三時許，沉敵艦三艘，運送銘軍八營，得以乘間登岸。
units.en: When the Japanese came up, he directed the gun crews in their defense; after three hours of fierce fighting three enemy ships were sunk, and eight battalions of the Ming Army were transported and able to land by seizing the interval.
units.literal: When Japanese ships arrived, he directed all the gunners in resisting them; after fierce fighting of about three hours, three enemy ships were sunk; he transported eight battalions of the Ming army, enabling them to land by seizing an interval.

units.zh: 論功，晉記名提督，易其勇號曰格洪額。
units.en: For this service he was advanced to registered nominal provincial commander and his brave-title was changed to Gehong'e.
units.literal: For merit he was promoted to registered nominal provincial commander and his brave title was changed to Gehong'e.

units.zh: 明年，戰威海，中彈死。
units.en: The following year, fighting at Weihai, he was struck by a shell and killed.
units.literal: The next year, fighting at Weihai, he was struck by a shell and died.

units.zh: 步蟾通西學，海軍規制多出其手。
units.en: Buchan was thoroughly versed in Western learning, and much of the navy's regulations were of his drafting.
units.literal: Buchan was versed in Western learning, and much of the navy's regulations came from his hand.

units.zh: 顧喜引用鄉人，視統帥丁汝昌蔑如也，時論責其不能和衷，致僨事。
units.en: Yet he favored fellow provincials and treated Admiral Ding Ruchang with contempt; contemporaries blamed him for refusing to cooperate with his commander, which helped bring on defeat.
units.literal: Yet he liked to employ men from his home district and looked down on the commander-in-chief Ding Ruchang; contemporary opinion blamed him for failing to work in harmony and thereby bringing on disaster.

units.zh: 然華人明海戰術，步蟾為最先，雖敗挫，殺敵甚眾。
units.en: Yet among Chinese who truly understood naval warfare, Buchan was the first; though the fleet was beaten, he killed a great many of the enemy.
units.literal: Yet among Chinese who understood naval tactics, Buchan was foremost; though defeated, he killed very many of the enemy.

units.zh: 上嘉其忠烈，詔優恤。
units.en: The throne honored his loyal death and ordered generous compensation for his family.
units.literal: The throne praised his loyalty and valor and ordered generous compensation.

units.zh: 其左翼總兵林泰曾，亦籍侯官，同為船政學堂卒業生。
units.en: His left-wing commander Lin Taiceng was also a native of Houguan and a fellow graduate of the Naval Academy.
units.literal: His left-wing commander Lin Taiceng was also registered in Houguan and was likewise a graduate of the Naval Academy.

units.zh: 管鎮遠，戰大東溝，發砲敏捷，士卒用命，撲救火彈甚力，機營砲位無少損，賜號霍春助巴圖魯。
units.en: Commanding the Zhenyuan at Dadonggou, he fired with speed and precision; his crew obeyed without flinching and fought hard to put out incendiary shells, so that the engine-room batteries were scarcely touched; he was granted the title Huochunzhu Batulu.
units.literal: He commanded the Zhenyuan; at the battle of Dadonggou he fired with agility, his soldiers obeyed orders, he fought hard to extinguish incendiary shells, and the engine-room gun positions suffered no damage; he was granted the title Huochunzhu Batulu.

units.zh: 駛還威海，艦觸礁受傷，憤恨蹈海死。
units.en: On the return to Weihai his ship struck a reef and was damaged; in shame and fury he threw himself into the sea and drowned.
units.literal: Sailing back to Weihai, the ship struck a reef and was damaged; in anger and shame he threw himself into the sea and died.

units.zh: 副將左翼中營游擊楊用霖、廣東大鵬協右營守備黃祖蓮並殉焉。
units.en: Yang Yonglin, guerrilla officer of the left-wing central battalion, and Huang Zulian, garrison commander of the Guangdong Dapeng Brigade's right battalion, died with him as well.
units.literal: Vice Commander and left-wing central battalion guerrilla officer Yang Yonglin and Guangdong Dapeng Brigade right battalion garrison commander Huang Zulian also died with him.

units.zh: 優恤各如製。
units.en: Each was generously compensated according to regulation.
units.literal: Generous compensation was granted to each according to regulation.

units.zh: 祖蓮等，忠義有傳。
units.en: Zulian and the others, too, have their own stories of loyal service.
units.literal: Zulian and the others — their loyalty and righteousness have been handed down.

units.zh: 戴宗騫，字孝侯，安徽壽州人。
units.en: Dai Zongqian, styled Xiaohou, was a native of Shouzhou in Anhui.
units.literal: Dai Zongqian, courtesy name Xiaohou, a native of Shouzhou in Anhui.

units.zh: 少以廩生治鄉團，捻酋苗沛霖數陷州，宗騫潛結各圩寨以攜貳其黨。
units.en: As a young licentiate he organized local militia; when the Nian chieftain Miao Peilin repeatedly seized the prefecture, Zongqian secretly won over the surrounding stockaded villages and turned Miao's own followers against him.
units.literal: In youth, as a licentiate he organized local militia; the Nian chieftain Miao Peilin repeatedly seized the prefecture; Zongqian secretly won over the various stockaded hamlets to divide his followers.

units.zh: 同治初，謁李鴻章，上平捻十策，深器之，遂留參戎幕，積勳至知縣。
units.en: Early in the Tongzhi reign he sought out Li Hongzhang and presented ten strategies for pacifying the Nian; Hongzhang was deeply impressed and kept him on his staff, where he rose by merit to magistrate.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tongzhi he called on Li Hongzhang and presented ten strategies for pacifying the Nian; Hongzhang greatly valued him and kept him on the military staff, where he accumulated merit until he reached the rank of magistrate.

units.zh: 十一年，治南運河堤工。
units.en: In the eleventh year he supervised dike works on the Southern Grand Canal.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, he supervised dikes on the Southern Grand Canal.

units.zh: 時畿輔興水利，計臣慮餉詘，議裁兵。
units.en: Water conservancy was then being promoted around the capital, but the finance minister, fearing a shortfall in revenue, proposed cutting the army.
units.literal: At that time water conservancy was being promoted in the capital region; the finance minister, fearing short revenue, proposed cutting troops.

units.zh: 宗騫上書，略謂：「津沽為九河故道，漳、衛交匯，水菑衍溢。
units.en: Zongqian submitted a memorial arguing, in brief: "The Tianjin area lies in the old channel of the Nine Rivers, where the Zhang and Wei meet and floods spread without check.
units.literal: Zongqian submitted a memorial, stating in summary: "Jingu is the old channel of the Nine Rivers; the Zhang and Wei rivers meet here, and floodwaters spread far and wide.

units.zh: 宜闢減河洩其勢，澌枝河分其漲，俾淮、練軍治之，則兵農合一，事半而功倍。」
units.en: Relief channels should be cut to release the pressure, and branch streams opened to divide the flood; put the Huai and Lian armies to the work, and soldier and farmer will be one — half the labor, twice the gain."
units.literal: Relief channels should be opened to release the force of the waters, and branch streams cut to divide the flood; let the Huai and Lian armies manage this, and soldier and farmer will be united — half the effort, double the result."

units.zh: 鴻章以其議上聞，遂命董其役，成稻田六萬餘畝。
units.en: Hongzhang forwarded the proposal to the throne and put Zongqian in charge of the project; more than sixty thousand mu of paddy were brought under cultivation.
units.literal: Hongzhang reported his proposal to the throne and ordered him to direct the project; more than sixty thousand mu of paddy fields were brought into cultivation.

units.zh: 箸海上屯田志紀其事。
units.en: He recorded the undertaking in his Record of Coastal Garrison Farms.
units.literal: He wrote the Record of Coastal Garrison Farms to commemorate the affair.

units.zh: 光緒六年，中俄失和，吳大澂被命佐吉林邊務，奏宗騫自隨。
units.en: In the sixth year of Guangxu, when relations with Russia broke down, Wu Dacheng was ordered to assist in Jilin border affairs and memorialized that Zongqian accompany him.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, when China and Russia fell out, Wu Dacheng was ordered to assist in Jilin border affairs and memorialized that Zongqian accompany him.

units.zh: 大澂兼攝屯政，宗騫為治道路，築砲台，設江防，徙直、東流民，假予產業，分部護之。
units.en: Wu also took charge of frontier colonization; Zongqian built roads, erected forts, organized river defenses, resettled refugees from Zhili and the east, lent them land and tools, and posted guards to protect them by district.
units.literal: Dacheng also took charge of garrison-farm administration; Zongqian built roads, erected forts, set up river defenses, moved refugees from Zhili and the east, lent them property, and stationed guards by division to protect them.

units.zh: 塞外灌莽千里，馬賊為民患，宗騫曰：「此屯政蠹也！」
units.en: Beyond the passes scrubland stretched for a thousand li, and mounted bandits preyed on the settlers; Zongqian said, "This is the ruin of our colonization work!"
units.literal: Beyond the passes, scrub and marsh stretched for a thousand li, and mounted bandits plagued the people; Zongqian said: "This is the bane of garrison colonization!"

units.zh: 率將士步馳八九百里，獲渠率王林等駢誅之。
units.en: He led his officers and men on a march of eight or nine hundred li, captured the ringleaders Wang Lin and others, and put them all to death.
units.literal: He led officers and men on foot and horse for eight or nine hundred li, captured the ringleaders Wang Lin and others, and executed them all together.

units.zh: 又以緣邊荒墾，戶籍殘耗，客民渙居不相顧，因令屯聚一處，略仿內地保甲，杜絕姦宄。
units.en: Because the frontier was newly opened and population registers were thin, migrant settlers lived scattered and could not protect one another; he ordered them to cluster together and organized them roughly on the interior baojia model to shut out crime.
units.literal: Moreover, because the borderlands were newly opened to cultivation and household registers were depleted, migrant settlers lived scattered and did not look out for one another; he therefore ordered them to cluster in one place, roughly imitating the interior baojia system, to cut off villainy.

units.zh: 復設製造局、採金廠，行之期年，商民輻湊。
units.en: He also set up an arsenal and gold works; within a year merchants and settlers were flocking in.
units.literal: He also established an arsenal and gold-mining works; after a year in operation, merchants and commoners gathered in great numbers.

units.zh: 大澂上其績狀，遷知府。
units.en: Wu reported his achievements and he was promoted to prefect.
units.literal: Dacheng reported his achievements and he was promoted to prefect.

units.zh: 八年，徙防洋、蒲河兩海口。
units.en: In the eighth year he was transferred to defend the harbors of Fangyang and Puhe.
units.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to defend the two harbors of Fangyang and Puhe.

units.zh: 遭母憂歸，鴻章疏留，宗騫請終制，弗許。
units.en: When his mother died he went home to mourn; Hongzhang memorialized to keep him in service; Zongqian asked to complete the full mourning period but was refused.
units.literal: When his mother died he returned home in mourning; Hongzhang memorialized to retain him; Zongqian asked to complete the full mourning period but was not permitted.

units.zh: 時興海軍，練水師，闢軍港，檄防威海。
units.en: The navy was then being built up, the fleet trained, and a naval base established; he was ordered by dispatch to take charge of the defenses at Weihai.
units.literal: At that time the navy was being built up, the fleet trained, a naval base opened, and he was ordered by dispatch to defend Weihai.

units.zh: 十三年，詣軍所，壁金線頂山，分鞏軍駐南岸，綏軍駐北岸。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he took up his post, fortified Jinxian Peak, and posted the Gong army on the south bank and the Sui army on the north.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, he went to the garrison, fortified Jinxian Peak, and stationed the Gong army on the south bank and the Sui army on the north bank.

units.zh: 明年，建兩岸海台各三，南曰趙北嘴、鹿角嘴、龍廟嘴，北曰北山嘴、黃泥崖、祭祀台。
units.en: The following year he built three coastal batteries on each shore: on the south, Zhaobeizui, Lujiaozui, and Longmiaozui; on the north, Beishanzui, Huangniya, and Jisitai.
units.literal: The next year, three coastal batteries were built on each shore: on the south, Zhaobeizui, Lujiaozui, and Longmiaozui; on the north, Beishanzui, Huangniya, and Jisitai.

units.zh: 後路分築陸台四，南岸口較闊，更建日島地阱砲台，屹然為東防重鎮。
units.en: Four land batteries were added in the rear; because the southern entrance was wider, he also built a masked battery on Rijiao Island, making Weihai a formidable eastern bastion.
units.literal: Four land batteries were built in the rear; the southern mouth was wider, and a masked battery was additionally built on Rijiao; the place stood firm as the great eastern defensive stronghold.

units.zh: 十七年，校閱海軍禮成，論功晉道員。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, after the naval review ceremonies were completed, he was promoted to circuit intendant for his services.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, when the naval review ceremonies were completed, he was promoted to circuit intendant for merit.

units.zh: 威海地瘠，士氣衰，更斥貲立義塾，延名師，至是始聞謳誦聲。
units.en: Weihai was a poor, dispirited place; he spent his own money to found a charitable school and hire distinguished teachers, and for the first time the sound of students reciting their lessons was heard there.
units.literal: Weihai's land was poor and local morale had declined; he further spent his own funds to establish a charitable school and invited famous teachers; only then did the sound of chanting lessons begin to be heard.

units.zh: 二十年夏，日艦來攻，率師御之，傷其艦四艘，再至再敗之。
units.en: In the summer of the twentieth year Japanese warships attacked; he led the defense, damaged four enemy ships, and beat them back again when they returned.
units.literal: In the summer of the twentieth year, Japanese warships came to attack; he led his troops to resist, damaged four of their ships, and when they came again defeated them again.

units.zh: 既而旅順、大連相繼淪沒，威海勢益孤，電請北洋、山東益師，久弗應。
units.en: Then Lüshun and Dalian fell in turn, leaving Weihai ever more isolated; he telegraphed Beiyang and Shandong for reinforcements, but for a long time received no answer.
units.literal: Before long Lüshun and Dalian fell in succession; Weihai's position grew more isolated; he telegraphed the Beiyang and Shandong commands for reinforcements, but for a long time received no response.

units.zh: 其冬，連失文登、寧海。
units.en: That winter Wendeng and Ninghai fell in succession.
units.literal: That winter, Wendeng and Ninghai were lost in succession.

units.zh: 時宗騫守北岸，分統劉超佩守南岸，宗騫與約，寇至互相應。
units.en: Zongqian held the north bank while sub-commander Liu Chaopei held the south; they agreed to support each other when the enemy came.
units.literal: At that time Zongqian held the north bank and the sub-commander Liu Chaopei held the south bank; Zongqian agreed with him that when the enemy came they would support each other.

units.zh: 歲除，大風雪，戰橋頭集，綏軍大困，銳身救之出。
units.en: On New Year's Eve, in a driving snowstorm, fighting broke out at Qiaotouji; the Sui army was hard pressed, and he went in person to bring them out.
units.literal: On New Year's Eve, in heavy wind and snow, fighting broke out at Qiaotouji; the Sui army was in great distress, and he boldly went in person to rescue them.

units.zh: 逾歲，日軍至，輒敗去，折而南。
units.en: After the new year Japanese troops came up, were beaten back again and again, then turned south.
units.literal: After the new year, Japanese troops arrived, were repeatedly beaten off, then turned south.

units.zh: 宗騫往援，而超佩蹌踉遁，三台拱手讓敵，反訴巡撫李秉衡，誣宗騫背約。
units.en: Zongqian went to help, but Chaopei fled in disorder and surrendered three batteries without a fight; he then reported to Governor Li Bingheng, falsely accusing Zongqian of breaking their agreement.
units.literal: Zongqian went to their aid, but Chaopei fled in disorder; the three batteries were surrendered to the enemy without a fight; he instead reported to Governor Li Bingheng, falsely accusing Zongqian of breaking their agreement.

units.zh: 宗騫抗辯，願復三台贖罪。
units.en: Zongqian defended himself and offered to retake the three batteries to atone for the loss.
units.literal: Zongqian protested in defense and offered to recover the three batteries to atone for his fault.

units.zh: 乃募敢死士奪還二台，唯龍廟嘴未復。
units.en: He raised a band of volunteers and recaptured two of the batteries; only Longmiaozui remained in enemy hands.
units.literal: He then recruited dare-to-die men and recaptured two batteries; only Longmiaozui was not recovered.

units.zh: 日軍倏大集，二台仍不守，宗騫退歸，登祭祀台。
units.en: The Japanese suddenly massed in force; the two batteries could not be held; Zongqian fell back and took his stand on Jisitai.
units.literal: Japanese troops suddenly gathered in force; the two batteries still could not be held; Zongqian withdrew and mounted Jisitai.

units.zh: 所部卒譁變，宗騫佯弗省，行數武，槍齊發，材官追斬一人，眾散走。
units.en: His troops mutinied; Zongqian pretended not to notice; after he had walked a few paces the mutineers opened fire together; a sergeant ran one man down and cut off his head, and the rest scattered.
units.literal: His troops mutinied; Zongqian pretended not to notice; after he had walked a few paces, guns fired together; a sergeant pursued and beheaded one man, and the crowd scattered and fled.

units.zh: 宗騫既登，乃無一從者。
units.en: By the time Zongqian reached the battery, not a single man was still with him.
units.literal: Once Zongqian had mounted the battery, not a single man followed him.

units.zh: 夜宿藥庫，丁汝昌詣籌戰守策，宗騫曰：「綏、鞏軍已西去，孤台危棘，恐資敵。」
units.en: That night he slept in the powder magazine; Ding Ruchang came to discuss strategy, and Zongqian said, "The Sui and Gong armies have already gone west; this isolated battery is untenable and will only arm the enemy."
units.literal: That night he lodged in the powder magazine; Ding Ruchang came to discuss attack and defense; Zongqian said: "The Sui and Gong armies have already gone west; this isolated battery is in peril and may only supply the enemy."

units.zh: 汝昌令毀台，強掖之下。
units.en: Ruchang ordered the battery destroyed and had him brought down by force.
units.literal: Ruchang ordered the battery destroyed and forcibly helped him down.

units.zh: 宗騫念南北各有地阱台，此其勢尚可為，乃詣劉公島就副將張德山。
units.en: Zongqian thought that with masked batteries on both shores the defense might still be saved, and went to Liugong Island to see Vice Commander Zhang Deshan.
units.literal: Zongqian reflected that north and south each had masked batteries and the situation could still be managed; he therefore went to Liugong Island to see Vice Commander Zhang Deshan.

units.zh: 德山無戰守志，宗騫飲金死，威海師遂熸。
units.en: Deshan had no stomach for a fight; Zongqian took poison and died, and the Weihai garrison was lost.
units.literal: Deshan had no will to fight or hold; Zongqian took poison and died, and the Weihai forces were extinguished.

units.zh: 鴻章以死事聞，詔優恤。
units.en: Hongzhang reported his death in service, and the throne ordered generous compensation.
units.literal: Hongzhang reported his death in service, and the throne ordered generous compensation.

units.zh: 復以秉衡請，贈太常寺卿。
units.en: On Bingheng's further petition, he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
units.literal: On Bingheng's further petition, he was posthumously made Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 論曰：中東之戰，陸軍皆遁，寶貴獨死平壤；
units.en: The historian comments: In the war with Japan, the land armies all fled, but Baogui alone died at Pyongyang;
units.literal: The historian comments: In the China–Japan War, the land armies all fled, but Baogui alone died at Pyongyang;

units.zh: 海軍皆降，世昌獨死東溝。
units.en: the navy all surrendered, but Shichang alone died at Dadonggou.
units.literal: the navy all surrendered, but Shichang alone died at Dadonggou.

units.zh: 中外傳其壯節，並稱「雙忠」。
units.en: Their heroic deaths were celebrated far and wide, and the two were paired as the "Two Loyal Ones."
units.literal: Within and beyond the realm their heroic deaths were told, and they were jointly called the "Two Loyal Ones."

units.zh: 及日兵入奉，永山獨死鳳城，敵遂長驅進矣。
units.en: When Japanese troops entered Fengtian, Yong Shan alone died at Fengcheng, and the enemy drove on unchecked.
units.literal: When Japanese troops entered Fengtian, Yong Shan alone died at Fengcheng, and the enemy then drove deep inland.

units.zh: 旅、大既失，威海勢孤，步蟾、宗騫皆先後誓死。
units.en: After Lüshun and Dalian fell, Weihai was cut off; Buchan and Zongqian each in turn swore to die for the cause.
units.literal: After Lüshun and Dalian were lost, Weihai stood isolated; Buchan and Zongqian each in turn swore to die.

units.zh: 士氣如此，豈遂不可一戰？
units.en: With spirit like this in the ranks, could they really not have fought once more?
units.literal: With morale such as this, could they truly not have fought one more battle?

units.zh: 此主兵者之責。
units.en: That failure lay with those who commanded the armies.
units.literal: This was the responsibility of those who commanded the armies.

units.zh: 五人雖敗，猶有榮焉！
units.en: Though these five men were defeated, they died with honor!
units.literal: Though these five men were defeated, they still had honor!
